title: What shape of hole will each cut paper show when opened?
description: Four folded sheets are cut along dotted lines, and the shape of each hole has to be predicted before cutting. A cut goes through every layer, so it appears again as a mirror picture across each fold.
teaching_notes: One idea: a cut through folded layers is repeated as a mirror picture across each fold, and two folds make the cut appear four times. Watch for students who draw the cut only once.

video_script.why: The child predicts the opened shape by copying each cut across every fold: one fold doubles the cut, and two folds make it appear four times.
video_script.substitution: Open the folds in your mind, one at a time, copying the cut across each crease.
video_script.anchor: four folded sheets with dotted cut lines: two green, one purple and one yellow
video_script.payoff_line: Every cut appears again as a mirror picture across each fold

final_answer.value: In every case the opened paper shows the cut and its mirror image across each fold line
final_answer.spoken: the opened paper shows the cut and its mirror picture across each fold

names.{{NAME_4}}: activity: punch holes in folded paper to create symmetric patterns

never_show: an opened sheet with the cut shown only once
maths_rules: One fold: 2 layers, so the cut is copied once, as a mirror image across the fold
Two folds: 2 x 2 = 4 layers, so the cut appears 4 times, once in each quarter
Green sheet, wavy cut: a bow-tie like shape with wavy sides, symmetric about the fold line
Green sheet, banner cut: a banner shape with an arrow-head notch at each end, symmetric about the fold line
Purple sheet, folded twice: notches at the edges and corners, and small rectangular holes placed symmetrically on both sides of the vertical and the horizontal fold
Yellow sheet, folded once: a rectangle with notches on both the left and right edges and a square hole in the middle
Check: folding the opened sheet back along each crease makes the halves match
video_script.design: One idea: a cut through folded layers is copied as a mirror picture across each fold. Assumes the child knows that a cut goes through every layer. Wrong idea: the cut shows up only once. The four sheets stay on the board all video.
open_questions: The figures of the four cuts could not be seen. The shapes of the holes follow the worklist answer; please check them against the printed figures.
